title: Plot: a time series
intro: Plot draws any column of a loaded log. The log, the view and the period are chosen in the first row, the columns in the list below it.

marks.d: Time series, annual values, depth profile through time, or profile at a date.
Hold Ctrl or Shift to draw several columns together.
Move over the chart to read the values.
Saves the figure as a picture with its source line.
Saves the plotted numbers as a table.
